candidates.rationale: This is the same HS6 subheading, 8517.62, without the EU national line. It is a less specific match for an import into FR.

title.en: Communication apparatus (excluding telephone sets or base stations); machines for the transmission or reception of voice, images or other data (including wired/wireless networks), n.e.c. in item no. 8517.6

candidates.rationale: The 8517.69 subheading covers other communication apparatus not elsewhere specified. The dock is more specifically a network and conversion device under 8517.62.
candidates.set_aside_reason: 8517.62 covers conversion and transmission of data more specifically than the residual 8517.69.
